## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused on one topic.
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and a bug fix has a test that fails without it.
- [ ] The changelog has a line under "Unreleased" for every user-visible change.
- [ ] Texts are available in German and English where users see them.
- [ ] No tokens, passwords, personal data or private hostnames are included.
